U1 unresolved-owners.notes: English 'every blocker listed, at least one, each a suspect terminal-receipt persistence write of a session' matches OnlyOwners and Owner; for count != 0, AllOwners is equivalent to OnlyOwners (AllOwnersSpec), and a truncated list (count above listed) fails AllOwners at Nil so it waits rather than proceeds.

W1 unlisted.notes: Nonzero count with no listed blockers returns Step(Waiting, tracked), as the English says. The law text is correct; the packet's reviewer example (count=65 with 64 omitted) is arithmetically wrong, see general item 1.

O1 oldest-tracked.notes: Under the non-owner nonempty premise Evaluate tracks Elems[i] (OldestSpec, OldestWalk) with its id, state and admitted time, and progress equal to Progress (ProgressSpec). The Oldest predicate matches the English: set admission before unset, first blocker on ties, first blocker when none is set.

R1 timer-reset.notes: Evaluate keeps tracked.since only when id, state, progress and admitted all match (Unchanged, via SameSpec equality), otherwise uses Signal(p, admitted, now). The English 'its progress time' means the judging session-latest progress p that O1 defines; say so explicitly at the next revision.

T1 stalled.notes: Stalled(o.id, Age(now, since)) when age >= limit, else Waiting, with since taken from the post-step tracked value; the zero clamp in Age matches the English.
